The edge-cone necessity/complete-blow-up sufficiency and exponentially high-probability superregularity reduce the random cover event to multinomial class-count cone membership up to O(exp(-cn)); n odd is impossible by bipartite balance. For n=2m, Pr(Bin(n,1/2)=m)~sqrt(2/(pi*n)); conditional independent within-side multinomials converge to a Gaussian in the balanced q-2 dimensional subspace, whose active facet inequalities yield a tangent-cone probability theta>0. Hence sqrt(n)P_n -> sqrt(2/pi)*theta. For S=P_{2r} with equal mass, inactive odd-edge constraints are positive and even-edge constraints form an exchangeable Gaussian bridge; unique cyclic minimum gives theta=1/r for all fixed r>=1.
